Reusable worlds (`<name>.world.json`, see the skill's references/cinestory/dynamic-worlds.md and worlds.md).

Ready-made: `rumah` (house: living room, kitchen, bedroom, back corridor, terrace), `sekolah` (classroom, veranda corridor,
field), `kantor` (open-plan office, printer corner, CCTV view), `minimarket` (shop + street), `perpustakaan`
(library + park). `node scripts/worlds.mjs <id>` prints what a story can name in each. A story can also keep its
own world next to it: `stories/<id>/<name>.world.json` — move it here when another film will need it.
